source: Offline isolated clone verified against all 30 exact source inventory entries; 38 statically active tests unchanged.

dependency_reuse.method: Every cached package file and archive rehashed; complete per-package inventories checked. Same exact Cargo.toml/lock and platform as retained dependency resolution; zero downloads or cargo metadata processes.

tooling: Verified exact rustc/cargo/Python hashes against retained toolchain; rustfmt used on new test file only (not a build/test). Stable rustfmt ignored existing nightly-only formatting options, retaining style diagnostics in tool output.
